Research

I lead the Network Enhanced Technologies Lab (NET Lab) at BYU. My research focuses on mobile networks, the Internet of Things, underwater networks, and wireless network management. I am interested in building real systems that enhance and extend wireless networks.

I received an NSF CRII award for early-career researchers in 2022 and an NSF CAREER award in 2025 for my work on wireless subprotocols. In 2021, I received my department’s Most Influential Faculty Member Award.

For a complete listing of my work, see my curriculum vitae.
